summary: We examine how closely pretrained LeWorldModel (LeWM) reproduces the effects of small action changes. Using matched simulator and model responses, we measure action sensitivity with Gram matrices at three perturbation scales.
takeaways: Using matched simulator and model responses, we measure action sensitivity with Gram matrices at three perturbation scales.
Geometry measured in pixels and embeddings varies more across scales than the chosen physical-state geometry.
On held-out directions, environment Grams achieve median embedding response errors of 17\% and 28\%, compared with 26\% and 38\% for an isotropic reference with the same trace.
